chain.label: FAA does not require CO detectors, adequate exhaust inspections, or minimum detector performance standards
chain.trigger: the FAA does not require CO detectors on enclosed-cabin general aviation aircraft with reciprocating engines

chain.label: Maintenance personnel missed exhaust system failures; mufflers failed well short of the 1,000-hour replacement interval
chain.trigger: maintenance personnel have likely missed exhaust system failures during inspections and that mufflers have failed in substantially fewer than 1,000 service hours

caused_by.evidence: the FAA did not require those inspection standards or the replacement frequency

chain.label: Undetected muffler corrosion, holes, and wall-thickness loss
chain.trigger: holes and wall thickness loss around the right muffler body

caused_by.evidence: the exhaust system had not been pressure checked (to identify holes in the muffler) as recommended in the FAA's enhanced inspection standards, but such an inspection was not required

chain.label: Exhaust/muffler failure introduces carbon monoxide into the enclosed cabin
chain.trigger: a defect, leak, or failure in the aircraft's exhaust pipes, muffler, or heat transfer system can introduce CO into the enclosed cabin

caused_by.evidence: which likely introduced CO into the cabin

chain.label: Installed CO detectors (passive 'spot' type) lack active alerting and do not meet a minimum performance standard
chain.trigger: the airplane's CO detector was a type known as a 'spot' detector...it does not include an active aural or visual alert and would therefore not be compliant with TSO C48A

caused_by.evidence: the FAA only recommends rather than requires compliance with TSO C48A for CO detectors used in aircraft

chain.label: Pilot inhales undetected CO, impairing judgment and aircraft-control ability, progressing to incapacitation
chain.trigger: continued exposure can lead to impaired judgment and decreased ability to control the aircraft...can be incapacitating and can lead to unconsciousness, coma, and death

caused_by.evidence: the pilot was not alerted to CO entering the cabin in enough time to counteract the effects of CO poisoning
a lack of required minimum standards for CO detectors can result in ineffective alerting if detectors do not meet those standards

chain.label: Pilot loses control of the aircraft while incapacitated by CO
chain.trigger: the airplane broke up in flight after the pilot's loss of control due to CO poisoning

caused_by.evidence: the pilot's flying abilities had degraded due to CO poisoning

chain.label: Airplane impacts/collides with terrain
chain.trigger: was destroyed when it impacted terrain near Newborn, Georgia

caused_by.evidence: collided with terrain near Guthrie Center, Iowa
the pilot and three passengers were fatally injured
